parameters: Wooden figure with Dandy...why is he standing here?
"No, nothing bad. It's just... Dandy asked me to
make a flower arrangement according to a recipe.
But I can't do it beautifully."
So he needs a flower arrangement..?
Don't you know why he needs it?
"No. I wanted to ask, but he ran away so quickly
that I didn't even have time to blink."
hehe, well that's just his style! Give a task and run away~
Why do you think it doesn't turn out nice?..
How many times have you tried?
"about five times for sure. but suddenly,
Teagan came to the floor... it was very unexpected."
"She came here to have tea in silence.
She invited me to sit with her but..."
"I can't sit down and drink tea without completing the task
from the Dandy...I'm afraid that he will be upset.."
Flutter, don't worry about it! If you want, we'll help you!
"is it possible? I will be so grateful to you..!"
Of course we can...What is the recipe?
1 of purple,2 of blue and 1 of white.."
oh, sounds simple! we'll get it done in no time!
Flutter!! we brought everything we need!!
Now we're going to put together a composition, right??
WOW!! What beauty!! Flutter, you just have golden hands...!
"yes...thank you very much..I like the result so much.."
"your diligence and desire to help inspired me so much
...Are you going to give these flowers to Dandy?
"Yes, I'm sure he will be delighted with our work."
"Take this as a token of my gratitude."
N-No need!..We helped you with pleasure.
